name: Rajarshi Chhatrapati Shahu Maharaj Shikshan Shulkh Shishyavrutti Yojna(EBC)
description: The objective of the Scheme is to provide financial assistance to the Economic Backward Class who are admitted to Diploma / Degree / Postgraduate Professional & Non Professional courses through Centralized Admission Process (CAP).
department: Maharashtra Council of Agriculture Education and Research (MCAER)
implementingAuthority: Maharashtra Council of Agriculture Education and Research (MCAER)

criteria.label: Eligibility Criteria: (As per the GR Dated 07th Oct 2017,01st March 2018, 31st March 2018) and 14th January 2019

evidence.quote: Eligibility Criteria: (As per the GR Dated 07th Oct 2017,01st March 2018, 31st March 2018) and 14th January 2019

criteria.label: a) Applicant should have Nationality of India.

evidence.quote: a) Applicant should have Nationality of India.
b) Candidate should be Domicile of Maharashtra State.

criteria.label: c) Applicant should be ”Bonafide Student of Institute” and admitted for Professional & Non Professional and Technical course (Diploma / Graduation / Post Graduation Degree) as mentioned in GR 14th January 2019

evidence.quote: c) Applicant should be ”Bonafide Student of Institute” and admitted for Professional & Non Professional and Technical course (Diploma / Graduation / Post Graduation Degree) as mentioned in GR 14th January 2019

criteria.label: d) Deemed University and Private university is not applicable

evidence.quote: d) Deemed University and Private university is not applicable

criteria.label: e) Candidate should be admitted through Centralized Admission Process (CAP).

evidence.quote: e) Candidate should be admitted through Centralized Admission Process (CAP).

criteria.label: f) Applicant should not avail any other scholarship/stipend.

evidence.quote: f) Applicant should not avail any other scholarship/stipend.

criteria.label: g) For current Academic Year, Only 2 child from family are allowed for benefit of scheme.

evidence.quote: g) For current Academic Year, Only 2 child from family are allowed for benefit of scheme.
h) The Total Annual Income of Family / Guardian should not be more than 8 Lakhs.

criteria.label: i) Minimum 50 % attendance in previous semester (Exception for fresh admitted in College).

evidence.quote: i) Minimum 50 % attendance in previous semester (Exception for fresh admitted in College).

criteria.label: j) During course duration, candidate should not have a gap of 2 or more than 2 years.

evidence.quote: j) During course duration, candidate should not have a gap of 2 or more than 2 years.

criteria.label: k) Candidates are eligible those who have taken an admission under General category and SEBC Category

evidence.quote: k) Candidates are eligible those who have taken an admission under General category and SEBC Category

benefits.text: 100 % of Tuition Fees and 100 % of Exam Fee.

evidence.quote: 100 % of Tuition Fees and 100 % of Exam Fee.

documents.name: b) Domicile Certificate of Maharashtra State.

evidence.quote: b) Domicile Certificate of Maharashtra State.

documents.name: d) Undertaking “In current year, not more than 2 beneficiary from family”.

evidence.quote: d) Undertaking “In current year, not more than 2 beneficiary from family”.

documents.name: f) Proof of Biometric attendance (Interface UIDAI).

evidence.quote: f) Proof of Biometric attendance (Interface UIDAI).

applicationProcess: For Academic Year 2026-27, apply on the MahaDBT 2.0 portal (fresh and renewal applications). The scheme page on MahaDBT 1.0 remains the information source.

applicationUrlEvidence.quote: Fresh and renewal applications for the Academic Year 2026-27 will be accepted only through the MahaDBT 2.0 Portal.
